app.name: ITZA
home.title: Every field has a memory.
home.body: ITZA reads your field's history from space and replays every real season on each candidate rotation, so you can see which rotation would have held up best and why.

methods.title: Methods and assumptions
methods.intro: How ITZA computes what it shows. Each section lists the formulas and the assumptions behind them.
methods.fao56.title: FAO-56 reference and crop water use
methods.fao56.assumption0: Daily weather comes from NASA POWER (temperature, humidity, wind, solar radiation).
methods.fao56.assumption1: Soil heat flux G is treated as zero at a daily step.
methods.fao56.assumption2: Kc follows the four FAO-56 growth stages; fallow uses a soil evaporation coefficient.
methods.waterBalance.title: Water balance
methods.waterBalance.formula:
Dr,i = Dr,i−1 − (P − RO) + ETc,adj + DP
Ks = 1 if Dr ≤ RAW, else (TAW − Dr) / ((1 − p)·TAW)
methods.waterBalance.assumption0: Runoff uses a simplified curve-number method by soil group and cover.
methods.waterBalance.assumption1: Water above field capacity drains away.
methods.waterBalance.assumption2: Root depth grows with crop stage.
methods.waterBalance.assumption3: Irrigation is not modeled or prescribed.
methods.scoring.title: Scoring and resilience
methods.scoring.formula:
Score(R, year) = Σ weight_k × criterion_k(R, year), weights sum to 1
Win rate = share of seasons where the rotation beats the baseline
methods.scoring.assumption0: Criteria are scaled from 0 to 1: climate fit, water balance, soil nitrogen, organic matter, erosion control, bare-field exposure, pest pressure and forage or income.
methods.scoring.assumption1: Weights come from your priority sliders.
methods.scoring.assumption2: Rankings are relative comparisons, not yield forecasts.
methods.monteCarlo.title: Monte Carlo uncertainty
methods.monteCarlo.formula: 200 seeded draws over Kc (±10%), soil water capacity (±20%), sowing date (±10 days) and depletion fraction (±0.1)
methods.monteCarlo.assumption0: The same seed always gives the same bands.
methods.monteCarlo.assumption1: Bands show how much the ranking depends on uncertain inputs.
methods.deltaChange.title: 2050 delta-change
methods.deltaChange.formula:
Future day = observed day + ΔT (temperature)
Future rain = observed rain × ratio (precipitation, capped)
methods.deltaChange.assumption0: Monthly factors compare 2041–2060 with 1995–2014 in NASA NEX-GDDP climate models, per emissions scenario.
methods.deltaChange.assumption1: Factors are applied to the observed 2001–2025 daily record, giving 25 plausible future seasons.
methods.deltaChange.assumption2: Future seasons are plausible, not predicted.
methods.fieldMemory.title: Field Memory
methods.fieldMemory.formula: Greenness series → smooth → find green-up, peak and senescence → label each season
methods.fieldMemory.assumption0: Satellite greenness comes from HLS (30 m) where available and MODIS (250 m) otherwise.
methods.fieldMemory.assumption1: Labels are inferred from timing and size of the greenness peak; your confirmation overrides them.
methods.fieldMemory.assumption2: Satellite estimates differ from ground measurements; soil tests and field observations take precedence.
glossary.ndvi.label: NDVI
glossary.ndvi.title: Vegetation greenness (e.g., NDVI)
glossary.ndvi.definition: A satellite score from 0 to 1; higher means more living plants.
glossary.et.label: ET
glossary.et.title: Evapotranspiration (ET)
glossary.et.definition: Water leaving the field through soil evaporation and plant breathing.
glossary.et0.label: ET0
glossary.et0.title: Reference ET (ET0)
glossary.et0.definition: How much water a standard grass field would use in today's weather.
glossary.kc.label: Kc
glossary.kc.title: Crop coefficient (Kc)
glossary.kc.definition: How thirsty a crop is compared with standard grass, by growth stage.
glossary.soilMoistureAnomaly.label: Soil moisture anomaly
glossary.soilMoistureAnomaly.title: Soil moisture anomaly
glossary.soilMoistureAnomaly.definition: How much wetter or drier the soil is than normal for that date.
glossary.waterBalance.label: Water balance
glossary.waterBalance.title: Water balance
glossary.waterBalance.definition: Rain and stored soil water minus what the crop needs.
glossary.frostRisk.label: Frost risk
glossary.frostRisk.title: Frost risk
glossary.frostRisk.definition: Chance of temperatures low enough to damage a crop at a sensitive stage.
glossary.fallow.label: Fallow
glossary.fallow.title: Fallow
glossary.fallow.definition: A season when the field is left unplanted.
glossary.seasonReplay.label: Season Replay
glossary.seasonReplay.title: Season Replay
glossary.seasonReplay.definition: Testing a rotation against real past weather to see how it would have performed.
glossary.ssp.label: SSP
glossary.ssp.title: Emissions scenario (SSP)
glossary.ssp.definition: A standard climate-future storyline (low, middle or high emissions).
glossary.managementZone.label: Management zone
glossary.managementZone.title: Management zone
glossary.managementZone.definition: A part of a field that behaves consistently differently from the rest.
glossary.groundTruth.label: Ground truth
glossary.groundTruth.title: Ground truth
glossary.groundTruth.definition: Independently recorded facts (e.g., official crop maps) used to check ITZA's estimates.
glossary.informationNeed.label: Information need
glossary.informationNeed.title: Information need
glossary.informationNeed.definition: A kind of data the product requires (e.g., daily rainfall), independent of which dataset provides it.
glossary.genUi.label: Generative interface
glossary.genUi.title: Generative interface (GenUI)
glossary.genUi.definition: An assistant that answers by assembling interactive screens (charts, cards, forms) from approved building blocks, instead of replying with text only.
disclaimer.judgment: ITZA supports farmer judgment and local agricultural expertise; it does not replace either.
disclaimer.relative: Rankings are relative comparisons from historical data, projections and simplified models, not forecasts or guarantees.
disclaimer.gaps: Every recommendation lists information gaps and risks that need local review.
disclaimer.satellite: Satellite estimates differ from ground measurements; soil tests and field observations take precedence.
